ann_88.original: Heavy daytime use raises the model's predicted churn through three hinges, and a voicemail plan keeps the main one shut. For a typical customer without a voicemail plan (day charge moved in step with day minutes), the predicted risk is 2.3% at 150 day minutes and 2.3% at 200, then rises to 14.2% at 250 and 94.8% at 300. With a voicemail plan and 30 messages the same four steps give 1.5%, 1.5%, 1.9% and 19.0%: the plan enters unit 3460, the hinge on day minutes and charge, with a negative weight and keeps it closed, so the charge hinges are what remains. Evening charge counts as well: unit 5604 adds day and evening charge, so at 200 day minutes raising the evening charge from 17 to 30 dollars lifts the risk from 2.3% to 27.1%. On the training data unit 3460 is open for 995 customers, whose churn rate is 28.3% against 9.5% for the other 3005; the steepest hinge, unit 1254, is open for 164 customers, whose churn rate is 62.2%. A fourth unit, 387, pulls the other way: it is open for 3028 customers (it is closed by many voicemail messages). For the typical customer, whose day hinges 3460 and 4045 are shut (values 0.00 and 0.00), the part changes the score by -0.55 logit. Unit 387 grows with international minutes, and shrinks as the day-and-evening charge hinge 4045 rises. Switching the whole part off lowers the training AUC from 0.9095 to 0.7977.

ann_89.original: Customer service calls are the second driver, through two hinges that open from the third or fourth call. For the typical customer at 150 day minutes the predicted risk is 2% at 2 calls, 5% at 3, 24% at 4, 66% at 5 and 92% at 6 calls; through this part the score gains 0.00 logit at 2 calls and 6.11 at 6. Unit 5395 subtracts day charge, so the climb is steeper for light day users: at 4 calls the part adds 2.59 logit at 150 day minutes but 0.78 at 250, where unit 5395 stays at 0.00. This matches the training data: the 318 customers with 4 or more calls churn at 50.0% against 11.1% for the other 3682, and the model's mean risk for them is 46%. Unit 9203 is open for 848 training customers and unit 5395 for 810. Switching the part off lowers the training AUC from 0.9095 to 0.8043.

For the typical customer, whose day hinges 3460 and 4045 are shut (values 0.00 and 0.00), the part changes the score by -0.55 logit. parts.original_hypothesis: A long serial chain that, on the training data, changes the prediction for North Dakota customers (68 of 68) and for 0 customers in other states. Its exit, unit 1887, is open for those North Dakota customers and changes their score by -0.22 logit on average; North Dakota's training churn rate is 11.8% against 14.2% elsewhere, so this is a state offset fitted to 68 rows. Moving the typical customer to North Dakota changes the predicted risk from 2.3% (West Virginia) to 1.8%. The rest of the chain (units 13212, 8290, 948, 13939, 11368 and 14533) fires for Wyoming: unit 948 is open for 89 Wyoming customers and for 0 others. It feeds 1887 with negative weights, but 1887 is already closed for Wyoming customers, so this branch acts on 0 of them; for the Wyoming case the part's contribution is 0.00. Switching the part off leaves the training AUC at 0.9095.
